note: Roles per position type in FC 27 (fut.gg role pages, Oct 2026; ST page was the FC 26 copy). Each slot in a club tactic gets a role AND a focus. Focus lists are only what the source pages showed, so an empty list means 'set in game'. In Clubs, a player's Role Rating is judged against the role the slot is given (EA Clubs Deep Dive), and the lobby shows Role Fit for each vacant slot.
